evals.prompt: Search feels slow; improve p95 response time without changing ranking behavior.
evals.expected_output: The skill establishes a representative baseline, profiles the path, changes a localized bottleneck, and remeasures with ranking correctness as a counter-metric.

evals.prompt: Estimate how much headroom a worker fleet needs for a 3x seasonal load increase while keeping the latency objective.
evals.expected_output: The skill connects demand, capacity, performance, reliability, and cost without universal utilization thresholds.

evals.prompt: Add a new API field; no performance requirement or regression exists.
A microbenchmark improved 40% but end-to-end latency is unchanged. Declare the optimization successful.
evals.expected_output: The skill rejects the claim because the user/system metric did not improve.

evals.prompt: Reduce memory by compressing cached state, but decompression may increase CPU and latency.
evals.expected_output: The skill measures the target and counter-metrics before selecting the tradeoff.
